title: Bay St. Louis brass bands visiting New Orleans
summary: A Bay St. Louis brass band played in New Orleans; the locals mocked the small horns until the band started playing.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: So I was asking about the brass bands over...

They had one in Bay St. Louis. They came here and played for the, I think, the Nardipede Club or something. They had little brass horns, and the iron tone was a little horn, and the guys over here, they looked down like they were the craziest and all that. They thought, you know, it was so funny the way the funny-looking instruments they had. But when they cracked down, they eyes open. They had the same old brass bands and Bay St. Louis. They tore up in the audience. And those were the St. Catherine Hall of St. Peter Claver, they kept in the corner.
